title: fix(service-analytics)!: two granularities of one time dimension are refused on every face, not collapsed to the last one

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XB1hsVtuncZ5F5C4zpiftHC)_

Fixes #28799

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `timeDimensions` naming one dimension, spelled the same way, at two granularities is now refused `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 on the native strategy, the ObjectQL strategy and the draft preview, with the refusal each already gives one column asked twice under one name (#28765); every face served it as the last granularity's buckets and dropped the other entry. Nothing is widened: no package-root export, public member, answer member, error code or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs` says two granularities of one time dimension are served.

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing on `queryDataset` (`@objectstack/service-analytics`), on every face.

Card thread: `session_01FEkQ5kbUJTTWAxjV9nqr1P`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`timeDimensions` 里同一个维度（同样写法）要了两个粒度（比如月和年）时，三条执行面（原生 SQL、ObjectQL、草稿预览）现在都返回 400 `INVALID_QUERY`，就是 #28765 那条「同一列被要了两次」的拒绝，字段逐一一致。之前三面都只保留最后一个粒度，另一个被静默丢掉；和原值维度一起查时，线上甚至给出一个 `1970-01` 的桶装着全部总数。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28799（p3），来自 #28794 的合约评审观察；按席位裁决「拒绝，不同时服务两个桶」。
- **风险与回滚**：这是收窄，需要合约评审（席位跑）。没有新增门禁：只是把两个构建器里「每个维度只记一个粒度」的 Map 改成保留全部粒度，让现有的重复列拒绝看见这一对。同一粒度要两次仍是一个桶、照常服务；不同列的桶照常服务。`packages/objectql` 未改，没有新的包根导出或公开成员。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` 新的 `granularitiesByDimension`，以及 `aggregateGroupKeys`、`executeCrossObject` 两处的用法。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts`，预期 34 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（收窄需先过合约评审）。

## What changes

- **`strategies/objectql-strategy.ts`, at the point that collapses.** Both group-key builders read `timeDimensions` through a `Map<dimension, granularity>` filled with `set`, so a second entry for one dimension overwrote the first. A module-level `granularitiesByDimension(query)` (not exported) now keeps every granularity per dimension in request order, and `aggregateGroupKeys` (the direct path, and the draft preview's door from #28765) and `executeCrossObject` push one bucket key per granularity through `pushGroupKey`. A dimension asked at two granularities therefore hands the engine two keys over one column, and the engine's existing duplicate-column refusal answers it; the native strategy declines a bucketed selection and the ObjectQL strategy answers it, so both live faces give that refusal, and the preview door, which judges the same keys, gives it too.
- **No new refusal, no new surface.** No gate is added, `packages/objectql` is untouched, and nothing is exported from the package root or added to a class.
- **The ruling.** Measured, every face dropped an entry silently, so the pair is refused, not served as two buckets (seat ruling: serving both would be a new answer shape no consumer asks for). The published `analytics.zod` text on precedence ("an explicit `timeDimensions` entry for that dimension wins, then this selection-level granularity…", `api/analytics.zod.ts` on `dateGranularity`) orders an entry against the selection-level and dataset defaults; it says nothing about two entries for one dimension, so it does not contradict refusing.
- Tests: seven cases added to `src/__tests__/preview-time-filter-fk-parity.test.ts` (now 34, real SQLite).
- Changeset `.changeset/28799-two-granularities-one-dimension-refused.md`, `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch, with the adr-0087 not-required marker.

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `1e019240` (real SQLite, every face), dataset over a deal object, rows 2026-03-01 / 100, 2026-04-01 / 50, 2026-04-02 / 30:

| selection | native | ObjectQL | preview | after (every face) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| td `closed_at` month + `closed_at` year | `2026`: 180 | same | same | `INVALID_QUERY`, `groupBy.1.field` |
| td `closed_at` year + `closed_at` month | 2026-03: 100, 2026-04: 80 | same | same | `INVALID_QUERY` |
| td `OBJECT.closed_at` month + year | `2026`: 180 | same | same | `INVALID_QUERY` |
| dims `closed_at` + td month + year | `1970-01`: 180 | same | `2026`: 180 | `INVALID_QUERY` |
| dims `region` + td month + year | amer 2026 150, emea 2026 30 | same | same | `INVALID_QUERY`, `groupBy.2.field` |
| td `closed_at` month twice | months | same | same | months (unchanged) |

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, read in the tree, not fixed: the SQL echo (`ObjectQLStrategy.generateSql`, `/analytics/sql`) builds its GROUP BY from its own one-granularity map, so for this pair it still renders one `year` bucket for a statement `execute` now refuses. It runs no engine, so no door judges it; making it refuse would be a new refusal there. Reported to the seat.
- The `#28798` alias wording is untouched, as the order says.
